## Codex Pointer 0.6.1

[Website / 双语主页](https://youisan.github.io/codex-pointer/)

Dragging the circle onto a window or dropping a file/folder onto it now selects the target without opening the task panel. Click the circle to open the selected target; click again to collapse. Reopening keeps the selection and draft, including while target lookup is in progress. Lookup completion or failure does not open a hidden panel.

拖动圆圈到目标窗口，或把文件、文件夹拖到圆圈后，只选择目标，面板保持收起。点击圆圈才展开，再点收起；保留已选对象和草稿。后台识别完成或失败均不会自动弹出面板。按 Esc 取消拖动时仍恢复拖动前状态。

Download **codex-pointer-0.6.1-windows-x64.zip** for the complete plugin. Quit the old circle, reload plugins or restart Codex, and reopen Pointer. English / Chinese UI continues to follow Codex's language setting.

升级前请先右键退出旧圆圈，重载插件或重启 Codex，再打开新版。
